# Data Tooly

> Data Tooly (https://datatooly.xyz) is a static site of 28 free, no-login data tools for developers, analysts and researchers, plus 50 code-first guides to public data APIs. 5 tools fetch live data in the browser; 23 are query builders that assemble a ready-to-run query and show a fixed example of the output shape. Each tool hands off to a production Apify actor for bulk runs.

Built and maintained by Omar Eldeeb (Apify Store handle: constructive_calm), who publishes 28 public data actors. Every page below has a clean markdown twin (the linked index.md); the HTML page is at the same URL without index.md. Full concatenated text: https://datatooly.xyz/llms-full.txt

## Tools by category

### Hiring & Sales Signals

- [Hiring & sales signal tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/hiring-sales-signals/index.md): Free tools that read company hiring signals from public job boards: live Greenhouse roles, an instant intent read, and an Apify actor for market-wide sweeps.
- [Company Hiring Signals — read buying intent from job postings](https://datatooly.xyz/company-hiring-signals/index.md): Live tool. See what any company is hiring for and what it signals. Free in-browser tool reads live Greenhouse roles and flags hiring intent. No login. Try it now.

### Patents & IP

- [Patent search & IP data tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/patents-ip/index.md): Build structured Google Patents queries by keyword, assignee or inventor, preview the exact record shape, then export at scale with an Apify actor.
- [Search Google Patents by company, inventor, or keyword — the structured way](https://datatooly.xyz/google-patents-search-builder/index.md): Query builder. Search Google Patents by company, inventor, or keyword the structured way. Free query builder + sample preview, plus a path to bulk CSV/JSON export. Try it.

### Social & Community

- [Social media & community data tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/social-community/index.md): Query builders for Reddit, Threads, Telegram and YouTube Shorts data: compose the search, preview the exact output fields, then run it on an Apify actor.
- [Search Reddit by keyword or subreddit — and export it clean](https://datatooly.xyz/reddit-search-builder/index.md): Query builder. Build a Reddit keyword/subreddit search query free in your browser, preview the output, then export posts + comments to CSV/JSON. No API key, no login.
- [Extract Telegram public channel posts](https://datatooly.xyz/telegram-channel-search/index.md): Query builder. Build a ready-to-run config to scrape Telegram channel posts, views, and reactions. Preview the output shape, then run it live on the Apify actor.
- [Scrape Threads profiles, posts & hashtags](https://datatooly.xyz/threads-profile-search/index.md): Query builder. Free Threads scraper query builder. Configure profile, posts & hashtag scrapes, preview the output shape, then run live on Apify. No login needed.
- [Monitor Threads by keyword or hashtag](https://datatooly.xyz/threads-keyword-monitor/index.md): Query builder. Build a Threads keyword or hashtag search, then schedule monitoring for new matching posts. Cookie-free public-web config for the Apify actor. Free to start.
- [YouTube Shorts Scraper — find viral Shorts by channel or keyword](https://datatooly.xyz/youtube-shorts-search/index.md): Query builder. Scrape YouTube Shorts by channel, keyword, hashtag, or URL. Get exact view, like, and comment counts, viral scores, and 360p downloads — no API key or quota.

### Dev & Community

- [Developer community data tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/dev-community/index.md): Search Hacker News live in your browser through the free Algolia HN API: stories, comments, points and dates, with an Apify actor for bulk exports.
- [Search Hacker News by keyword — live, with points and comments](https://datatooly.xyz/hacker-news-search/index.md): Live tool. Search Hacker News live in your browser with the public HN Algolia API: no key, no login. Filter by type, points and date, then copy the query for bulk export.

- [App Store Top Charts API: Free JSON by Country, No Key](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/app-store-top-charts-api/index.md): Get the App Store top free, paid and grossing charts as JSON for any country from the iTunes RSS feed. No key, works in the browser, with fetch() and curl code.
- [How to Check if ChatGPT Mentions Your Brand (Free)](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/check-if-chatgpt-mentions-your-brand/index.md): A free, step-by-step way to check if ChatGPT and other AI assistants mention your brand: buyer prompts, clean chats, repeat runs, a simple log, and scoring.
- [ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 in Python: query.cond, Phase, CSV](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/clinicaltrials-gov-api-export-csv-python/index.md): Query the free ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API with query.cond, filter by phase (filter.phase returns HTTP 400; use filter.advanced) and export CSV. No key needed.
- [Get Completed Clinical Trial Results with the API](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/clinicaltrials-gov-api-completed-trial-results/index.md): Find completed trials with posted results on ClinicalTrials.gov and read outcomes, p-values and adverse events from the v2 API resultsSection. Python included.
- [ClinicalTrials.gov API: Look Up a Study by NCT Number](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/clinicaltrials-gov-api-nct-number-lookup/index.md): Fetch one trial by NCT number with the ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API: the /studies/{nctId} endpoint, NCT format, fields, 404 vs 400, aliases and batch lookups.
- [ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 Query Parameters: Full Reference](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/clinicaltrials-gov-api-v2-query-parameters/index.md): Every ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 /studies parameter: query.cond, query.term, filter.advanced AREA[] syntax, filter.geo, aggFilters, sort, fields, paging. Tested.
- [ClinicalTrials.gov Classic API to v2: Migration Guide](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/clinicaltrials-gov-classic-api-v2-migration/index.md): The classic ClinicalTrials.gov API was retired on June 25, 2024. Map full_studies, study_fields, expr, min_rnk and fmt to API v2, or use the legacy XML shims.
- [Read Company Hiring Signals From Public Job Board APIs (with code)](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/company-hiring-signals-job-board-apis/index.md): Open job postings leak strategy. Learn to read company hiring signals from the public, no-auth Greenhouse API with a runnable JS classifier.
- [Cointelegraph API: Get Crypto News as JSON Without a Key](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/cointelegraph-api-crypto-news-json/index.md): Cointelegraph has no public news API, but its site runs on a keyless GraphQL endpoint and RSS feeds. Pull articles, search results and full text as JSON.
- [Price per sqm by Compound in New Cairo: Compute It with Python](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/new-cairo-price-per-sqm-by-compound-python/index.md): Stop trusting broker blogs: compute New Cairo apartment price per square meter by compound from live Property Finder Egypt listings, split ready vs off-plan.
- [Facebook Ad Library Scraper: API Limits and the Real Approach](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/facebook-ad-library-scraper/index.md): Why the official Meta Ad Library API only covers political ads, and how to build a Facebook ad library scraper for commercial competitor ads instead.
- [FPL API Endpoints: Complete Reference for 2026/27](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/fpl-api-endpoints-reference/index.md): Every public Fantasy Premier League API endpoint, checked live in 2026/27: bootstrap-static, fixtures, live, entry, picks, leagues, with key fields and errors.
- [FPL Fixture Difficulty (FDR) from the API in Python](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/fpl-fixture-difficulty-api/index.md): Read FPL fixture difficulty from the free API: team_h_difficulty, team_a_difficulty, how they map to team strength, and a Python table of the next 5 gameweeks.
- [FPL API Price Change Data in Python: The Official 2026/27 Fields](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/fpl-api-price-change-data-python/index.md): Read FPL's own price-change predictions from the free bootstrap-static API in Python: price_change_percent, projections, likelihood, and the ±100 rule.
- [FPL Live Gameweek Points from the API: Picks Math](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/fpl-live-gameweek-points-api/index.md): Compute any FPL team's gameweek score from event/{gw}/live and picks: multipliers, captaincy, chips, hits and auto-subs. Python checked against 300 teams.
- [Find Your FPL Manager ID and Pull Your Team History](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/fpl-manager-id-team-history-api/index.md): Where to find your Fantasy Premier League manager (team) ID, then pull every gameweek, chip, transfer and past season for it from the free FPL API in Python.
- [How to Export Google Patents to CSV (Honest Guide to Every Real Path)](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/export-google-patents-to-csv/index.md): A precise, no-hype guide to exporting Google Patents search results to CSV — the built-in 1,000-row cap, the BigQuery bulk path, and why browser scraping fails.
- [How to Extract Dubai Used Car Listings Data from Gulf Marketplaces](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/dubai-used-car-listings-data/index.md): A practical, honest guide to extracting Dubai used car listings data from DubiCars, YallaMotor, and Dubizzle Motors using JSON-LD and embedded __NEXT_DATA__.
- [HN Algolia API Reference: Search, Tags, Filters, Limits](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/hacker-news-algolia-api-reference/index.md): The Hacker News Algolia API in one page: /search vs /search_by_date, every tag, numericFilters, hitsPerPage, the 1,000-hit cap, /items and /users. Tested live.
- [Get All Comments for a Hacker News Story with the API](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/hacker-news-api-get-all-comments/index.md): Three ways to download every comment on a Hacker News thread: the Algolia item tree, the search index and the Firebase API. Tested Python, and what each misses.
- [Hacker News Firebase API vs Algolia: Which One to Use](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/hacker-news-firebase-api-vs-algolia/index.md): HN's official Firebase API (topstories, item, user) vs the Algolia search API: endpoints, rate limits, freshness and speed, tested side by side in Python.

- [How AI Assistants Choose Which Brands and Sources to Cite](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/how-ai-assistants-choose-brands-sources/index.md): What OpenAI, Perplexity, Anthropic and Google document about how their assistants pick sources: web search, crawlers, robots.txt. Plus a crawler check script.
